armed-conflicts.headline: Middle East tensions escalate with US-Saudi strikes; Ukraine seeks arms production
armed-conflicts.summary: On July 29, 2026, the US and Saudi Arabia conducted strikes against Iran-backed groups in eastern Iraq following drone attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure. This occurred after Iran launched missiles at a US base in Jordan, which were intercepted. Meanwhile, Ukrainian President Zelenskiy met with US President Trump to discuss reviving peace talks with Russia and securing Patriot missile production for Ukraine, amidst continued conflict.

climate-events.headline: Weakening US environmental rules coincides with global extreme weather

public-health.headline: Air pollution impacts reproductive health; Chad refugee camps face water crisis

humanitarian.headline: Acute water crisis for Sudanese refugees; genocide warnings in Sudan
humanitarian.summary: On July 29, 2026, Sudanese refugees in Chad's Goudrane camp were facing an acute water crisis, with over 938,000 refugees battling severe shortages and aid stretched thin, leading to widespread health problems. Simultaneously, 'genocide warnings' were reiterated for El Obeid, Sudan, where hundreds of thousands are trapped under siege with infrastructure attacks and risk of mass atrocities. Funding cuts also limited food assistance for over 390,000 vulnerable Syrian refugees in Jordan.
